title: Structured-offset G0: do deliberate ~2 cm end-effector offsets create choices worth ranking?
question: At a given state, does picking among the policy chunk shifted ~2 cm along +-x/y/z beat the plain chunk (imagination premise)?
headline: Gate passes in both probes: cross-validated best-of-8 offset beats the plain chunk by +12.5 [+5.6, +19.8] (hold 1) and +12.1 [+4.9, +19.3] (hold 4) points, vs +0.6 for noise candidates in G0. No single direction replicates (z+ height hypothesis: -1.9 / +2.5). Next per the rule: G1 on offset proposals.
